protocol.scope: historical conditional scoring for specified observed paired lineups; it does not assess pregame availability, player causality, optimizer counterfactuals, or game forecasts

baselines.leagueVenue: train plus tune history home and away points per possession

intervals.method: tune residual quantiles scaled by square root of possession exposure
intervals.publicationRule: Report coverage separately; publish no player uncertainty or lineup intervals unless pooled heldout coverage is within five percentage points of nominal.

acceptance.pooledDirectionalMseVersusLeagueAndTeam: positive lower paired 95 percent confidence bound
acceptance.pooledNetMseVersusZeroAndTeam: positive lower paired 95 percent confidence bound
acceptance.seasonGuardrail: at most one directional MSE harm versus team context across the nine completed seasons
acceptance.playerClaim: no individual-player validation, causal-effect, availability, or prospective claim

protocol.historicalEvidenceLabel: chronological historical development assessment on completed 2017-18 through 2025-26 regular seasons; no 2026-27 data is included

checks.name: no-game-date-leakage
checks.details: Chronological splitter assigns every whole America/Chicago game date to exactly one partition before fitting or scoring.

limitations: Observed target-game paired lineups are conditioning inputs, not inferred pregame availability.
No individual-player causal-effect, player-ranking, counterfactual rotation, workload, box-score, game-score, win-probability, or prospective claim is made.
All evaluation seasons are completed historical data and remain development evidence.
Per-player uncertainty is not estimated by this assessment.
Archive selection and possession reconstruction exclusions remain disclosed in the immutable input receipt.
